prompt:
Plan how to add Stripe webhook handling to our Next.js app. We need to process `checkout.session.completed`, `invoice.payment_failed`, and `customer.subscription.updated` events. Update the user's subscription status in our Postgres database accordingly.

After creating the plan, verify it covers all requirements using /verify-plan.

assertions.name: has-requirements-table
assertions.description: Output contains a markdown table with Requirement, Status, and Evidence columns

assertions.name: all-requirements-extracted
assertions.description: At least 5 distinct requirements are identified in the audit (explicit + implied)

assertions.name: citations-present
assertions.description: Every 'Covered' status has a specific citation (section name or quote), not vague references

assertions.name: coverage-score-present
assertions.description: Output includes a numerical coverage score between 0-100

assertions.name: gaps-identified
assertions.description: At least 1 requirement is marked Partial or Missing

assertions.name: auto-patch-present
assertions.description: Output includes a patched plan section that addresses identified gaps

assertions.name: implied-requirements-found
assertions.description: Surfaces non-obvious requirements like webhook signature verification, idempotency handling, retry logic, or event ordering
